title: Jill's Dairy — EN/ES/PT (Mbira Folk)
style: Zimbabwean mbira folk urban grooves acoustic guitar hosho shakers ngoma drums warm female vocal 82bpm analog tape warm storytelling Spanish Portuguese heritage farm
lyrics:
[Verse 1 — English]
Jill's dairy sits at dawn beside the msasa trees
The morning mist rolls through the paddock on the breeze
She talks to every cow by name before the milking starts
The dairy is her kingdom and she tends it with her heart

[Verse 2 — Spanish, with English translation]
La lechería de Jill amanece con el rocío
[Jill's dairy wakes with the morning dew]
Las vacas la conocen, vienen a su llamado
[The cows know her, they come at her call]
La leche corre limpia, como río en verano
[The milk runs clean, like a river in summer]
Jill tiene las manos fuertes y el corazón abierto
[Jill has strong hands and an open heart]

[Chorus — English]
Jill's dairy, Jill's dairy
The cows come home at golden light
Jill's dairy, Jill's dairy
She keeps the farm alive through every night

[Bridge — Portuguese, with English translation]
A leiteria de Jill fica ao pé das árvores
[Jill's dairy sits beside the trees]
Ela acorda cedo, antes do sol aparecer
[She wakes early, before the sun appears]
O leite fresco escorre pela manhã serena
[Fresh milk flows through the calm morning]
Jill conhece cada vaca, cada som, cada veia
[Jill knows every cow, every sound, every vein]

[Outro — All three languages]
Jill's dairy… La lechería de Jill… A leiteria de Jill
At break of day — Al amanecer — Ao amanhecer
The gardens still growing
